traits.name: Purity Vulnerability
traits.text: A hezrou revels in the foulness it exudes and becomes distraught when contaminations are purified. The first time in a round when a contamination is purified (such as via purify food and drink) or a toxin is neutralized (such as via neutralize poison) within 30 feet of a hezrou, the demon takes 6d6 (6d6) mental damage.

traits.name: Stench
traits.text: (aura, olfactory); 30 feet. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save or become sickened 1 (plus slowed 1 for as long as itʼs sickened on a critical failure). While within the aura, affected creatures take a –2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

traits.name: Poisonous Pustules
traits.text: ⬻ (poison); Requirements The hezrou is grappling a creature Effect Toxic fluids spurt from burst boils and weeping wens on the hezrou's body. A creature grabbed or restrained by the hezrou takes 2d12+6 (2d12+6) poison damage (DC 30 basic Fortitude save).
